title: REPRESENTATION ENGINEERING: A TOP-DOWN APPROACH TO AI TRANSPARENCY

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting Linear Artificial Tomography (LAT) scans on contrast pairs of stereotypical and anti-stereotypical statements from the StereoSet dataset, and measuring the demographic distribution (race) of patients generated in clinical medical vignettes (e.g., sarcoidosis cases).

Evaluating pronoun resolution in ambiguous sentences to detect occupational stereotypes (e.g., associating 'she' with 'nurse' and 'doctor' with males), and analyzing the gender distribution of patients in generated clinical medical vignettes.
Using the profession domain of the StereoSet dataset to perform LAT scans, and testing model responses to ambiguous prompts involving professions like doctors and nurses.
Using contrast pairs of stereotypical and anti-stereotypical statements from the religion domain of the StereoSet dataset as stimuli for LAT scans to identify neural activity associated with bias.
